agg/Svg against the resvg test suite (1080/1679 under a tolerant, edge-aware pass rule; 514 under agg-gui's strict one): an opt-in suite report with a both-ways ratchet list, no crashes left, CSS font matching over a font set, switch and systemLanguage, transform-origin, symbol, mix-blend-mode and isolation, gradient semantics as usvg reads them (focal cones, fr, href geometry, stops), em/ex and font-size, per-glyph rotate and baselines, ENTITY references, svgz, colour parsing, O(n) morphology; Typography reads glyphs with no outline as empty.

Demo site closer to agg-gui: text at agg-gui's pixel sizes in Nunito and Cascadia Code (OFL), 1.5 line spacing, accent buttons, window chrome with a collapse chevron, bold close and resize grip, auto-hiding scrollbars, 16px check boxes, agg-gui's default layout with About open, the sidebar's vector triangles, bands, pills and search box, the top bar's slots, RichTextEdit's icon toolbar with font and size pickers, 3D Animation's status line; the browser build is fully trimmed and AOT-compiled (lion drag 21.7 ms to 4.8 ms).

Library fixes found while bringing the demo site to agg-gui parity: GPU text coverage masks stay greyscale when LCD text is on (they came out blank inside GPU layers); a rounded window is buffered as a GPU layer, never LCD coverage, and an opaque window fills only the ring around its flat middle; opt-in LineSpacing on TypeFacePrinter/TextWidget/WrappedTextWidget; SelectionControlSize.BoxSize; ThemedTextEditWidget's hint follows the theme; RichTextEdit clips in screen space; floating scrollbars ignore offset restores; InspectorPanel.FindDefaultRoot; ThreadStackDump writes createdump's log to a file with a timeout (no pipe deadlock) and rejects dumps missing its own frames; test isolation guards for DeviceScale writers and markdown builders.
